habitat: Arctic tundra; meadows; marshes; open grasslands; coastal areas; and agricultural fields
story: Discover the stunning Snowy Owl (*Bubo scandiacus*), a member of the diverse Strigidae family. Native to Arctic tundra; meadows; marshes; open grasslands; coastal areas; and agricultural fields, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Vulnerable (VU) on the IUCN Red List, the Snowy Owl represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
